Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/catalog/galaxies.ts:24

The three grand spirals — the Milky Way renders as a seeded volumetric particle galaxy (never a face-on photo: we are inside it), centered at MW_CENTER so the Sun lands on its true 0.51 galactocentric ring with a heliocentric exclusion bubble keeping disc particles off the solar system. Sagittarius A* parents onto the disc center so its accretion composite inherits the galactic tilt. Andromeda and Triangulum land at their true (l, b) directions on Local-Group-tier distances (~11.9k / ~12.8k units).
